title: Source Inventory, Scale Taxonomy & Authority Map
objective: Resolve and implement one read-only governed source inventory, scale taxonomy and authority map for strategic command and large-scale conflict, preserving ordinary Action/Combat/Event truth, constituent identity, owner-domain state and no-duplicate-state/effects boundaries while authorizing no command/order/resolution mechanics.

tranche_context.expansion_rule: Context expansion is denied unless a named source is missing/contradictory, changed validation evidence identifies a concrete dependency, canonical branch/authority state drifts, or the owner explicitly requests expansion.

source_inventory.scl_role: canonical encounter/combat resolution references; SCL-01 creates no second combat ledger

source_inventory.authority: D17 owns Asset/inventory/state; MIB-14 owns reusable vehicle/platform/base operational definitions and governed transitions
World/Reality/Timeline/location identity and canonical world state
versioned economic scopes, trade links, costs and settlement
source_inventory.scl_role: read-only logistics/economic source references; no economic mutation

source_inventory.authority: relationship/social runtime truth and derived reputation projections
organization, load, loyalty/cohesion, delegation, resources, crisis, integration, GM/advisory and golden-proof semantics
source_inventory.scl_role: completed organization/leadership handoff references without reopening ODL mechanics

source_inventory.authority: read-only continuity/dependency/consequence analysis over owner domains
source_inventory.scl_role: advisory consequence/continuity references only; owner domains remain authoritative
routing input for identity-preserving individual-to-squad-to-fleet scale transitions; never runtime truth

scale_taxonomy.meaning: one canonical Character/Creature/Vehicle/Asset actor resolved by existing owner systems
small coordinated command grouping of canonical constituents
reusable aggregate grouping of canonical constituents/assets
coordinated grouping of units under a strategic relationship
army/fleet-level grouping of formations, units and platforms
multi-force strategic context over owner-authored World/Scene/Objective references

resolved_contract.scale_rule: Scale labels express coordination/aggregation role, not universal numeric size caps. SCL-02 owns later unit/profile composition definitions.
resolved_contract.projection_rule: Up-scale projection carries explicit canonical constituent ids, visible state references and provenance; it does not copy or fork authoritative Character, Asset, inventory, Vehicle, damage, casualty, Event, Organization, Economy or World state.
resolved_contract.reconciliation_rule: SCL-01 performs no down-scale mutation. Later aggregate outcomes must reconcile through explicit owner-domain proposals/commits; SCL-09 is the primary casualty/damage reconciliation tranche and may not double-apply effects.
resolved_contract.handoff_rule: SCL-03/04 own future command/order/resolution mechanics; SCL-08 owns platform/fleet integration; SCL-09 owns individual-to-unit effects; SCL-10 owns owner-domain strategic consequence integration. SCL-01 supplies only the source/scale/authority map.
resolved_contract.visibility_rule: Permission/visibility filtering occurs before source inclusion, counts, aggregation, projection, search text, provenance, deterministic receipts or AI context. Hidden existence and hidden cardinality remain undisclosed.
resolved_contract.unknown_conflict_rule: Missing, hidden, conflicting or identity-incompatible source evidence remains explicit unknown/conflict/incompatible and is never auto-reconciled or promoted to authority.
resolved_contract.ai_rule: AI may only advise where separately governed; SCL-01 invokes no provider and grants no command, order, adjudication, permission, mutation or completion authority.
resolved_contract.persistence: No durable SCL-01 ledger or migration. Migration 0022 remains unreserved.

acceptance_contract.red_rule: Acceptance/proof/profile/verifier land before production contract/panel and must fail on the intended missing production surfaces after invariants/install pass on both self-hosted lanes.
acceptance_contract.green_rule: Exactly one SCL-01 current-family profile passes exact-head repository health, self-hosted Linux, self-hosted Windows and deterministic comparison with zero historical predecessor fanout.

preserved_boundaries: ODL-01..09 remain completed_verified with implementation authority retired.
A6 Action, A7 Combat, D17 Asset/inventory/state, MIB-11/D18/A10 World, MIB-13 Economy, D25/MIB-09 relationship/reputation, WCI and ODL owner boundaries remain unchanged.
SCL-01 creates no authoritative unit state, command hierarchy, order, phase, mechanical resolution, casualty/damage application, strategic consequence or owner mutation.
Constituent identity persists across scale and no duplicate authoritative state/effects are authorized.
No AI provider invocation, AI command/adjudication, hidden-data reveal, durable persistence or migration 0022 is authorized.
SCL-02+, MAL-01+, provider activation, tester distribution, release and deployment remain unauthorized.

retry_basis.evidence: Owner Continue governed-started SCL-01 from unchanged canonical AIOC/application baselines and sealed only the minimum named source/authority envelope.
changed_since_previous: SCL-01 moved from selected_not_started to in_progress.
A single bounded implementation branch and authority are established.
Exact source inventory, nonnumeric scale taxonomy, identity-preserving projection rules and owner-domain handoffs are resolved before application mutation.
